content: MDN docs establish that Intl.Segmenter provides locale-sensitive word segmentation and Unicode property escapes support Cyrillic script/letters; String.normalize helps canonical/compatibility normalization. These primitives do not perform Russian morphological stemming or semantic synonym matching, so exact-token matches can miss inflected forms and synonyms; score explanations and a tested dictionary are needed. Sources: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/Segmenter ; https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String/normalize ; https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Regular_expressions/Unicode_character_class_escape
